prerequisites_note: SQL 70 (aws/workflows/sql/70_ingest_shared_check.sql, SECURITY DEFINER public.aws_ingest_shared_check(jsonb)) is a prerequisite: without it ingest-shared-check.mjs falls back to an inline UPDATE as checksops of columns SQL 89 does not grant. The tool reports ingest_function_present and ingest_function_security_definer and refuses apply (sql70_ingest_function_security_definer) unless both are true. It also refuses while any SECURITY INVOKER function, or one owned by a role with checksops' privileges, UPDATEs the table (update_functions_safe), unless the role authenticated exists (authenticated_role_present), while any LOGIN role other than checksops uses authenticated's privileges (authenticated_has_no_other_login_members: it would lose UPDATE when SQL 89 revokes UPDATE from authenticated), while any role checksops is a member of other than authenticated holds UPDATE on the table (no_other_inherited_update: SQL 89 would not revoke it), and unless every UPDATE entry of authenticated and PUBLIC was granted by the login (inherited_update_granted_by_login).
